propositions: A new glob-triggered advisory code-review overlay `surface-parity` must be added to the four-pass gate to flag when a write-op's parameter/guard/required-field surface changes on one adapter (CLI, lib, MCP) without sibling adapters being updated in lockstep.

The overlay is dispatched via glob routing on write-surface files (_commands/*, _lib_writes.py, _mcp_writes.py) and stays inert on unrelated diffs; it is wired into round_a and round_b batches of the code-review gate topology so the finder actually runs.

The overlay is advisory-first (blocking_enabled=false, block_threshold=0.95, not in approved blocking set) and carries false-positive guards (deliberate justified divergence, adapter-bound non-caller-visible params, internal refactors with no caller-visible surface change).
Registry, routing, base-reviewer catalog, and workflow gate definitions are updated in lockstep; the base-reviewer overlay enumeration must exactly match OVERLAY_IDS (strict drift gate).

A packaged reviewer prompt is created with frontmatter (dimension, langfuse_prompt, outputs, execution_mode, category) matching the deletion-impact and api-compat contract; reviewers/index.json is unchanged (overlays excluded from catalog).
